title: Evaluation Type Definitions
summary: This module defines various types of evaluators used in the pydantic_evals framework, including common case-level evaluators and report-level evaluators for aggregate analysis. It provides tools for LLM-based judging, content checks, type checks, and statistical report generation like ROC AUC, Precision-Recall, KS, and Confusion Matrices.

nodes.label: Base Evaluator
nodes.title: Abstract Base Evaluator
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all evaluators, defining the common interface for assessing outputs.

nodes.label: Report Evaluator Base
nodes.title: Report-Level Evaluator Base
nodes.description: Abstract base class for evaluators that analyze an entire report of cases, producing aggregate metrics and visualizations.

nodes.label: LLM Judge
nodes.title: LLM-Powered Output Judge
nodes.description: Evaluator that uses a Large Language Model (LLM) to judge the quality of an output against a specified rubric.

nodes.label: Contains Check
nodes.title: Output Content Checker
nodes.description: Evaluator that checks if an output contains a specific value or substring, supporting various data types.

nodes.label: Type Instance Check
nodes.title: Output Type Verifier
nodes.description: Evaluator that verifies if an output is an instance of a particular type, identified by its name.

nodes.label: ROC AUC Calculator
nodes.title: ROC AUC Metric Generator
nodes.description: Calculates the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve and Area Under the Curve (AUC) for binary classification tasks from evaluation scores.

nodes.label: Precision-Recall Calculator
nodes.title: Precision-Recall Metric Generator
nodes.description: Computes the Precision-Recall curve and its Area Under the Curve (AUC) for binary classification, based on evaluation scores.

nodes.label: Kolmogorov-Smirnov Calculator
nodes.title: Kolmogorov-Smirnov Statistic
nodes.description: Determines the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) statistic and plots the empirical cumulative distribution functions (CDFs) for positive and negative case scores.

nodes.label: Confusion Matrix Generator
nodes.title: Classification Confusion Matrix
nodes.description: Generates a confusion matrix to summarize the performance of a classification model across different classes.

nodes.label: LLM Models
nodes.title: LLM Model Interface
nodes.description: Provides an abstract interface for interacting with various Large Language Models (LLMs).

nodes.label: Output Configuration
nodes.title: Evaluation Output Settings
nodes.description: Configuration settings for how evaluation results, such as scores or assertions, should be structured and included.

nodes.label: Evaluation Reason
nodes.title: Evaluation Result Details
nodes.description: A structured object containing a boolean evaluation result and an optional string reason for the outcome.

nodes.label: Report Analysis Result
nodes.title: Aggregate Report Output
nodes.description: A base type representing any form of analysis or visualization generated by a report evaluator.

nodes.label: Evaluation Context
nodes.title: Case Evaluation Data
nodes.description: Contextual information provided to case-level evaluators, including inputs, output, and expected output.

nodes.label: Report Evaluation Context
nodes.title: Full Report Evaluation Data
nodes.description: Contextual information provided to report-level evaluators, including the full report of all evaluated cases.

groups.label: Case-Level Evaluators
groups.title: Individual Case Assessment
groups.description: Evaluators designed to assess the output of a single case or interaction, providing immediate feedback on specific criteria.

groups.label: Report-Level Evaluators
groups.title: Aggregate Report Analysis
groups.description: Evaluators that perform aggregate analysis across an entire set of evaluation cases, generating statistical reports and visualizations.

groups.label: Base Evaluator Classes
groups.title: Core Evaluator Foundations
groups.description: Fundamental abstract classes that define the common interfaces and behaviors for all evaluators within the framework.
